sources.title: Using AI Models - shallowseek User Manual
sources.snippet: Using AI Models Overview shallowseek provides a fully OpenAI-compatible API format. You can use any OpenAI SDK or OpenAI-compatible client directly — just change the Base URL and API Key.

sources.title: GitHub - daggerhashjack/ShallowSeek: Ollama on Android: AI Unleashed
sources.snippet: ShallowSeek is a mobile application that provides a user-friendly interface for interacting with Ollama's language models on your local machine. It consists of an Android client app built with Jetpack Compose and a Node.js server that acts as a middleware between the app and Ollama.

sources.title: Ollama
sources.snippet: Ollama is the easiest way to automate your work using open models, while keeping your data safe.

sources.title: OpenCode Guide - shallowseek User Manual
sources.snippet: OpenCode is an open-source terminal AI programming tool that supports multiple model providers. By configuring shallowseek's API endpoint, you can use OpenCode to access the platform's models for coding and project management.
